name: Rebate & Chargeback Management
one_liner: Rebate agreements, claim validation, chargebacks and accruals.
fits_when: you hold rebate or pricing agreements with wholesalers, GPOs, IDNs or payers
customers submit rebate claims that must be validated against contract terms and sales data
wholesalers charge back the difference between WAC and a contract price
finance books monthly rebate and chargeback accruals and trues them up
customers need their own login to submit claims and see only their own agreements and payments
accruals and payments need maker-checker sign-off and an audit trail
gives_you: Agreements with product terms, contract prices, rebate rates and an approval lifecycle
Rebate claims submitted by customers, auto-validated, with an exception queue for market access
Chargeback lines validated against the contract price, disputed or credited to the wholesaler
Monthly accruals per agreement with maker-checker posting and true-up against payments
An agreement 360 page with claims paid, chargebacks credited, accrued and an activity timeline
A gross-to-net dashboard by customer type and quarter

catalogue.description: A rebate and chargeback system for manufacturers that contract with wholesalers, GPOs, health systems and payers: set up agreements with product-level contract prices and rebate rates, take in rebate claims and chargeback lines from customers, validate them against contract terms and sales data, route exceptions to market access, pay and credit through the ERP, and book monthly accruals with maker-checker sign-off. Customers sign in to submit claims and chargebacks and see only their own.

compliance: Maker-checker sign-off on accrual postings and claim payments
Duplicate checks on chargeback invoice lines and claims per agreement and quarter
Contract terms and price changes approved before they take effect
Row-level access: each customer sees only its own agreements, claims and chargebacks
Audit trail of every validation, approval, payment and journal
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Rebate and chargeback management for our US specialty portfolio: about 40 GPO, IDN and PBM agreements and three national wholesalers sending chargebacks daily. Rebate claims arrive quarterly with utilisation data and are validated against contract terms and 867 sales data, with exceptions going to market access. Finance books monthly accruals with maker-checker sign-off and posts them, along with payments and credit memos, to SAP.
